messages.author: 9c9b5f9c6aaa025d
messages.subject: Re: reading in single row for color
parts:
Perhaps I don't understand your question and without a MWE, I am not sure what you are trying to do exactly. But passing strings for colors works fine for me.
df <- data.frame(A = 1:3, B = letters[1:3], stringsAsFactors = FALSE);
ggplot(df, aes(A, B)) + geom_point(color = "blue");
color <- "red";
ggplot(df, aes(A, B)) + geom_point(color = color);

Cheers,
Doug
